verdict: Clean, fully real implementation. Uses only genuine Baklava API: bl-accordion-group (real, default slot for bl-accordion) correctly wraps three bl-accordion elements, each using the real caption (string) attribute and default content slot; icon="info" is a valid BaklavaIcon reference. No hallucinated tags/attributes, no hand-rolled controls, and the FAQ grouping requirement is met. Only minor note: no explicit bl-toggle listener, which the basic expand/collapse handles internally, and icon value is not a strict enum so it is not machine-flagged.
